curation: group caller fragments before each next scripted-agent start; crop from first speech minus200ms through gold end plus1.5s, within original caller track; no added silence; reset ASR per annotated user turn
resampling: causal63tap 48kHz to16kHz FIR; no delay compensation; ~0.65ms filter delay, original annotation clock retained
labels: script-derived timing; identical annotation tracks are not three human annotators
baseline: 1.1s actual Silero silence timer, shadowed on same VAD frame delivery
streaming_asr: sherpa-onnx1.13.8 CPU int8 Zipformer chunk16 left64, cached stream per turn, greedy, 2threads, no endpoint reset or EOF flush
observation: 512-sample frames released at 32ms monotonic deadlines; no cached ASR/features or replayed service costs
features: frozen WavLM past<=5s, last<=50 hidden frames; FIFO worker; original scaler; no WORLD features because selected head does not consume them
availability: ASR accepted-prefix end is an upper bound on audio consumed by completed streaming decode; no claim of token alignment; reject earlier-gap features; score only same-gap acoustic results
stopping: first learned response cancels queued inference; launched work completes and is charged; continue VAD-only shadow until baseline response or real recording EOF
timing: physical monotonic elapsed response time; no simulated delays; no microphone capture, network, generated reply or user reaction
confounds: ASR backend changed from Parakeet to streaming Zipformer; not a causal comparison with prior results.
Six synthetic calls, five scripts and repeated stock voices; not real-human independent confirmation.
Gold annotations define user-turn crop/reset boundaries; this is not autonomous whole-conversation segmentation.
Original internal calibration thresholds frozen; no fitting or threshold search on this public pilot.
